design.title: Borrowed eyes: each committee member's from-scratch trunk is replaced by ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV3-Small blocks (BSD-3, baked in model/pretrained), fine-tuned at a tenth of the learning rate, so the place descriptor starts from invariances learned on a million photographs instead of three
design.init_strategy: pretrained:mobilenet_v3_small IMAGENET1K_V1 features[0..8] (torchvision, BSD-3; model/pretrained/mnv3s_features8.pt, fine-tuned at 0.1x LR) + from-scratch 1x1 lift, cosine head, offset head
design.eli5: Until now the drone's two 'navigators' had eyes that were grown from scratch by looking at only three aerial photographs of Berlin, so they learned those three photographs' quirks - that day's shadows, that camera's colours - and a fourth photograph of the same streets looked foreign to them. This experiment gives each navigator eyes that have already looked at about a million ordinary photographs and learned what edges, roads, roofs and textures look like in general, under all kinds of light and seasons; we then teach those eyes Berlin on top, gently, so the general knowledge is not overwritten. The hope is that eyes which already ignore lighting and season will recognise a Berlin street in a photograph they have never seen, which is exactly the test. Everything after the eyes - how the two navigators vote, how confidence is decided - stays the same.
design.hypothesis: Eleven experiments on this ruler have moved every stage except the one that decides what a place looks like. The held-out 2024 usable-fix rate has sat in a 6-14% band through all of them (exp 2: 7.0, exp 4: 11.75, exp 5: 12.5, exp 6: 14.2, exp 7: 7.5, exp 8: 9.2, exp 10: 6.3, exp 11: 10.75) while everything around it swung: training-survey fit at the same held-out viewpoints ranged 18% to 95% usable (exp 5 lifted it to 72-81% and 2024 stayed at 12.5%; exp 11 lifted it to 65-77% and 2024 read 10.75%), and the gate took 2024 false fixes from 43% to 7% (exps 7 and 11) without touching usable. The champion's own survey diagnostic says why: after the cosine head, each member still names the same cell for the same place in all three TRAINING surveys only 43-46% of the time (xsurvey_agree, clean lattice crops, heading 0), its within-place variance fraction did not move (0.286 vs 0.295 in exp 7; exp 11 predicted < 0.15), and clean per-survey top1 is 57-67% on photographs it trained on. Three fingerprints per tile remain the solution the trunk finds, whatever head, gate or auxiliary sits on it (exps 3, 8, 9, 10 all tried to pull the feature together and none bit), because the trunk itself - four plain 3x3 stride-2 convs, 150k parameters, initialised at random, 'Feature extractor' changed:true only once in this era (exp 5, which added depth on top of the same four layers) - has only ever seen three photographs of one city and has no reason to prefer the structure they share over the texture that tells them apart. This experiment changes what the trunk IS: each member's conv stack becomes torchvision's MobileNetV3-Small stem + first eight inverted-residual blocks (features[0..8], IMAGENET1K_V1, BSD-3, 190,520 parameters, 128x128 -> 48x8x8, same 8x8 grid and stride-16 the current trunk produces), followed by a trainable 1x1 lift 48->112 so the exp-11 cosine head, prototypes, offset head, pooling and committee gate are byte-for-byte the same design. The pretrained blocks are fine-tuned at a tenth of the head's learning rate so the invariances they arrive with are adapted to Berlin, not overwritten by it. The weights are already in the repository (model/pretrained/mnv3s_features8.pt, 195,168 values, verbatim torchvision tensors, loaded strict in the four-area era by commit 2d6f2cd's _build_pretrained_trunk, and the AWS code package ships the whole model/ directory, so nothing is downloaded on the box). Why this is the family the evidence points at and not another training signal: the one external representation this era has measured (exp 8's probe, three TRAINING captures only) found a place across surveys 95% of the time when aligned, 70% under the eval's 12 px shift and 23% under shift+rotation, against 90% / 7-11% / 1% for raw pixels - features learned on natural images at scale carry both the cross-survey and the off-lattice tolerance the eval demands, and exp 8 failed not because that was wrong but because a 1M-parameter student could not absorb it through distillation (student-teacher cosine 0.40 against 0.55 needed). Deploying pretrained features directly sidesteps distillation entirely: the invariance is in the weights on day one, and fine-tuning at 0.1x only has to attach Berlin's 2,970 prototypes to it. MobileNetV3-Small at features[0..8] is the right slice for this harness, not DINOv2: it is a CNN the ESP32-P4 toolchain ingests, its slice fits the 4 MiB gate twice over with the full 112-d head (design-stage sizing on the exact graph, runs/_probe_exp12_pretrained.py: two members export to 3,542,960 bytes, 3.38 MiB, 1,058,420 parameters, 1.3 ms host latency), and it is permissively licensed. Honest reading of the earlier-era record: the four-area era ran this trunk for ~30 experiments (its src_ids 11-40) and those models re-score at 1.77-2.00 on this ruler, but every one of them was trained on ONE photograph under a sigmoid confidence head that never abstains (false fix 77-99%, usable 0-0.5%), so their numbers measure a broken gate, not the trunk's cross-survey behaviour; the trunk has never been trained on three surveys, never under the committee gate, never under the cosine head, and never under paired batches with photometric randomisation. This is the 'change what the trunk is' move that exp 11's own decision rule (b) named for the case that compactness across three surveys did not reach a fourth, and that exp 7's rule (a) named as the accuracy move once the gate was in place; both conditions now hold. The deployed graph changes (new trunk, same head and decode); the training loss, targets, paired batches, augmentation, committee, schedule shape and views per epoch do not. Library L2 lists pretrained-feature routes as the largest documented effect in the scene-coordinate literature (ACE-G / R-SCoRe); this is that route in its deployable form.
